jobs.description: The photo ladder backlog (root ADR-0429, ADR-0427 §7): every hour, the display ladders of the photos the collectors stored (the court auction collect run makes none: root ADR-0566) are made from the Silver photo indexes the shared media store's contract names (data-go-kr-onbid.contract.json media.ladder_backlog.index_tables, today silver.court_auction_item_photo), through the same media_renditions::ensure_ladders the collectors call. Partial: a table whose Iceberg snapshot did not move is not read; otherwise only its rows from the newest source run taken on are added to the pending sources kept under its state path; a source whose ladder is there costs one HEAD. A new ladder version starts every table over. Bounded by media.ladder_backlog (1,500 sources, 4 at a time, 1,500 s). Writes only write-once rendition objects under the store's renditions/ prefix.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from its own bounds (root ADR-0457, ADR-0566): the Silver photo index read once, then sources until media.ladder_backlog.run_time_budget_seconds (1,500 s) stops the loop, four at a time, the four in flight (about 4.5 s each, ADR-0427's rav1e estimate) finishing after it: about 1,650 s, inside the 2,160 s share of the 40-minute limit. Each ladder is written once on its own (as_it_goes); what a run leaves the next hour takes.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation, not a data producer: `unchanged` is its normal outcome. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.
